experiences.method_family: succinct-formula NP verification and exhaustive complement decision
experiences.failure_mode: a succinctly declared variable universe makes the naive full assignment exponentially longer than the formula word and makes enumeration over all declared variables doubly exponential
residual_signature: valid O(t)-bit canonical words can declare v=2^t variables
only x_1 need occur in the decoded clauses
the frozen helper requires a witness tuple of length v
the frozen helper enumerates 2^v full assignments
the advertised polynomial NP verifier and 2^{O(n)} explicit decider are therefore false for those helpers
broken_assumptions: declared variable count was treated as polynomially bounded by its binary encoding length
a full assignment was treated as a polynomially balanced witness for a sparse formula
scope_conditions: the frozen full-v helper relations in C041_fx_sat_one_sided.py
canonical formulas permitting unused declared variables
binary gamma coding of the declared variable count
competing_diagnoses: reject every formula with an unused declared variable
renumber or normalize all formulas before decoding
retain the semantic language and verify only the variables occurring in literal slots
experiences.selected_diagnosis: The complexity defect is caused by measuring assignments over the declared universe rather than the occurring-variable support. Since at most 3m variables occur and the payload lies in the input word, sparse-support witnesses and search repair the bounds without changing the language.
experiences.falsifier_or_attempt: Declare v=2^t but use clauses mentioning only x_1; compare direct word length with the frozen helper witness length and assignment enumeration count.
experiences.observed_result: The word has length O(t), the frozen witness has length 2^t, and the frozen exhaustive loop has 2^(2^t) assignments. Restricting to occurring variables gives at most 3m=O(n) witness bits and 2^{O(n)} search.
local_repair_attempts: supply one truth bit per occurring variable in sorted order
enumerate assignments only on occurring-variable support
retain the exact SAT-to-old-new reduction and require follow-up proof review

links.rationale: Both failures arise from confusing the graph side length M_n with the direct Boolean input length and failing to audit which quantities are binary encoded versus explicitly written.
